gotchas: Guest checkout, no login needed. A hotel page with dates works as a deep link: /<hotel-slug>/hotel/<city-slug>.html?checkIn=YYYY-MM-DD&los=1&adults=1&rooms=1&children=0&currencyCode=USD. The slug is Agoda's own, not the hotel's name (Quality Inn & Suites Dallas-Cityplace is /best-western-cityplace-inn/); read it from a city page's hotel link (/city/<city-slug>.html). The search page's city= id is not guessable (8691 is Jakarta).

On the hotel page the room grid renders only after clicking the 'VIEW THIS DEAL' jump button (button[data-element-name=jump-nav-cheapest-room-btn], the visible one). Book buttons are button[data-element-name*=book]; the data-selenium attribute on them disappears after a re-render.

Two steps: guest details (names, email, Country/region of residence select defaulting to United States, country code combobox + input[autocomplete=tel-national]) then 'NEXT: FINAL STEP' (button[data-action=nextPage]) -> payment. 'You won't be charged yet' on step one; the cheapest rates are 'Extra low price! (non-refundable)', book and pay now.
A 'user drop-off' modal ([data-testid=bf-user-drop-off-alert-modal]) can appear over the details step after a pause and intercepts clicks on NEXT; close it with its button[aria-label*=close] first.

The card form is a hosted iframe, iframe[src*=secure.agoda.com] (title 'CCForm', /payment/index-v4.html; a hidden preload copy exists on step one), with cardholder name, number, MM/YY expiry and a REQUIRED CVC, all with standard autocomplete attributes, plus three checkboxes/radios that were left alone. Pass the frame for every card field and fill number and CVC back to back.
First fill of saved details on agoda.com raises the owner's destination approval; an expired request is not asked again in the same proxy session (open a new session to re-prompt).
